name: Injuu no Datenshi ~Requiem for Fallen Angels~
original_name: 淫従の堕天使 〜Requiem for Fallen Angels〜
source:
Hero lives with a lovely younger sister and suppresses affection for her. However, his friend knows of such feelings and invites hero to attack surrounding women. But hero has a subtle feeling that his sister is going to be involved as well sooner or later...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与可爱的妹妹共同生活，一直压抑着对她的爱慕。然而，他的朋友知道这份感情，还邀请主人公侵犯身边的其他女性。主人公却隐约觉得，妹妹迟早也会被卷入其中……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vndb-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
